pages.title: Scripture Account
pages.text: A batch fails and produces ashes if it contains incompatible additives, its conflict score reaches 35 or more, its stability falls below 20, or its toxicity reaches 60 or more.

pages.title: Scripture Account
pages.text: Pills that retain nonzero toxicity after successful refinement inflict Poison for 10 seconds when consumed.

pages.title: Scripture Account
pages.text: Ordinary material-purity and forging-success rules also apply to alchemy.
